issues.title: Document browser persistence
issues.acceptance: Filings notice, export and reset behavior match actual storage.

issues.title: Create first-run example

issues.title: Validate imports

issues.title: Implement workspace path boundary

issues.acceptance: Ordered events survive restart; evidence gaps remain explicit.

issues.title: Export reproducible evidence bundle

issues.title: Prototype editor integration

issues.title: Test interruption recovery

issues.title: Run accessibility review

issues.title: Publish contribution journey
issues.acceptance: Starter tasks have owner, acceptance criteria and reproducible setup.
